home.label: Home
home.selectionRule: Only recommend exercises that require bodyweight or a yoga mat.
home.notes: Confirmed user context: bodyweight-focused home training with a yoga mat. No door anchors, furniture anchors, bands, dumbbells or other equipment are assumed.

apartmentGym.label: Apartment Gym
apartmentGym.selectionRule: Until equipment photos are reviewed, only recommend confirmed home-safe exercises. Add equipment automatically after visual inventory review.
apartmentGym.notes: Do not guess machines or weights. Equipment will be populated from user-provided photos.

fullGym.label: Full Gym
fullGym.selectionRule: All normalized exercise equipment categories are available unless an exercise is later marked unavailable at the specific gym.
fullGym.notes: Generic all-equipment gym profile. Can be refined later without changing workout history.
